name: Pistol, two hands

contact.why: the firing palm on the grip's right side, the web of the hand high under the tang (FM 3-23.35 2-3)

index.why: the trigger finger straight along the frame, off the trigger until the shot

middle.why: wraps the front strap under the trigger guard

pinky.why: wraps the front strap at the grip's bottom

thumb.why: the firing thumb forward along the frame's left side, over the safety, clear of the slide

trigger.why: the trigger finger's pad on the trigger for the shot

contact.why: the support palm on the grip's left side, filling what the firing hand leaves open (FM 3-23.35 2-3)

index.why: the support fingers wrap over the firing hand's fingers, under the trigger guard

thumb.why: the support thumb forward along the frame under the firing thumb, clear of the slide's path

slide_rear.why: the slingshot (the action's rack): the support hand grips the slide's rear serrations from the gun's left and top, the fingers over the top to the right side, the thumb on the left side; the forearm stays near its middle roll

index.why: the fingers close on the slide's right serrations

middle.why: the fingers close on the slide's right serrations

ring.why: the fingers close on the slide's right serrations

pinky.why: the fingers close on the slide's right serrations

thumb.why: the thumb's ball against the slide's left side

slide_front.why: the press check: the hand over the slide's front, fingers and thumb pinching its sides to ease it back

index.why: the index and middle pinch the slide's right side

thumb.why: the thumb on the slide's left side

mag_grab.why: the magazine's base in the palm from below and the gun's left (the support hand's side, so the forearm turns no further than it can), the fingers along its front, the thumb along its back; the heel of the hand seats it

index.why: the fingers along the magazine's front

middle.why: the fingers along the magazine's front

ring.why: the fingers along the magazine's front

pinky.why: the fingers along the magazine's front

thumb.why: the thumb along the magazine's back

stance.why: both arms out in front with the elbows a little bent, the pistol below the line of sight and a little right of it (a two-handed ready hold; aimed, it rises to the eye); a guess at the first-person view

rules: both thumbs below the slide's lower edge (clear of the slide's path)
the trigger finger off the trigger outside the trigger clips

sources.title: FM 3-23.35, Combat Training with Pistols M9 and M11 (2003)
FM 23-35, Basic Field Manual: Automatic Pistol, Caliber .45 (1940)
